verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships its own built-in agent, `local-ai chat`, which answers questions, reads files and runs commands on your machine behind an approval gate. It also has a built-in agent platform, managed from its web interface, for creating and configuring agents with MCP tools. That directly covers delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what tasks the assistant can handle (e.g., whether it can manage LocalAI itself, such as installing models), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.
